ambiguities: Team set for design columns = teams appearing in the filtered Games set (after code replacement); unused teams would get coefficient 0 anyway.
Rank counts later pool games (pool is chronological by date, game_id) in which team plays, ties on same date broken by game_id order.
Pool 'season >= S-1' uses the season column of games; S is max season among games on date d.
Section A/B missing when pool<16 games; B with fewer kept games still fit (ridge keeps it solvable).
PBP game_id matched directly to games.csv game_id; pbp seasons only 2010+, so earlier games have no proe.
PBP rows with posteam OAK/SD/STL mapped; pass/rush==1 tested numerically, NaN treated as false.
proe 'last 12 such games' = last 12 games with n>0 dated strictly before d (games on same date as d excluded).
Reference sets for D/E: all team rows of earlier seasons with x present; kernel weights unnormalized by bandwidth; missing x rows excluded from both.
overtime==1 test numeric; missing overtime treated as 0.
Final points clipped? No: margin events use unclipped final scores.
